body: The United States Air Force is pushing ahead with a plan to pour 20 acres of concrete at Andersen Air Force Base in Guam to dramatically expand apron parking. The construction program was originally intended to be part of an expanded joint facility with the Republic of Singapore Air Force, but Singapore dropped out and the Air Force is still proceeding.

The choice of open aprons over protective shelters reflects the Air Force's agile combat employment concept, which emphasizes flexibility and unpredictability rather than predictable bases for high-value platforms. The report argues that permanent hangars are liabilities in a conflict, because modern satellite imagery maps their exact coordinates and makes them easy targets for long-range ballistic and cruise missiles. Andersen already hosts platforms including the Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit stealth bomber, and the smaller B-21 Raider can fit into a standard fighter shelter, but the Air Force has chosen not to build shelters so the airfield can still accommodate larger aircraft such as upgraded B-52 bombers.

The airfield upgrades go beyond concrete, with new fuel storage and refueling infrastructure to support faster hot-pit refueling, stormwater upgrades to withstand heavy monsoon rains, and an $8 billion enhanced integrated air defense system described as a 360-degree, multi-layer shield with 16 batteries across Guam. The expanded parking is intended to make Andersen a stronger staging and launch point for operations into the first island chain and a rally point for the air bridge between the continental United States and expeditionary forces in the Pacific.
en.summary: The US Air Force is expanding apron parking at Andersen Air Force Base in Guam with 20 acres of concrete, favouring open parking over shelters under its agile combat employment concept.
en.title: US Air Force expands Andersen AFB apron with 20 acres of concrete instead of shelters

body: 美國空軍正推動在關島安德森空軍基地澆築20英畝混凝土、大幅擴增停機坪的計畫。這項工程原本是與新加坡共和國空軍擴大聯合設施的一部分，新加坡退出後，美國空軍仍繼續推動。
選擇露天停機坪而非防護機棚，反映美國空軍敏捷作戰運用概念，強調彈性與不可預測性，而非讓高價值機隊固定使用可預測的基地。報導指出，固定機棚在衝突中反而是弱點，因為現代衛星影像已掌握其確切座標，容易成為長程彈道飛彈與巡弋飛彈的目標。安德森基地已駐有諾斯洛普·格魯曼B-2幽靈匿蹤轟炸機，較小的B-21突襲者雖然能停入標準戰鬥機機棚，但空軍選擇不建機棚，以便機場仍能容納B-52升級型等較大型飛機。
機場升級不只混凝土，還包括新的燃油儲存與加油設施，以加快熱加油作業、因應豪雨的排水升級，以及據稱耗資80億美元的強化整合防空系統，號稱是涵蓋關島16座防空陣地的360度多層防護網。擴增後的停機空間，旨在讓安德森成為深入第一島鏈作戰更強的集結與出發點，也是美國本土與太平洋遠征部隊之間空中橋梁的集結點。
zh.summary: 美國空軍在關島安德森空軍基地以20英畝混凝土擴增停機坪，依敏捷作戰運用概念選擇露天停放而非興建機棚。
zh.title: 美軍關島安德森基地擴增20英畝停機坪、不建機棚
